Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2024 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the call — proposed next steps

Sean / Marissa — thanks again for the intro and the overview today. Finovo is very interested in a technical demo focused on: SSO integration, data residency options, and expected cost per 10k monthly requests.

Quick recap from our side:
- Primary use case: real-time document summarization for customer support
- P0 constraints: < 300ms p95 for short prompts, support for SSO (SAML), and SOC2 compliance
- Procurement / legal will want a high-level SOW and an initial pricing ballpark

Can we schedule a 60-minute technical demo next week? Our team is available:
- Wed Apr 24: 09:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Apr 25: 13:00–16:00 PT

Also looping Priya (procurement) once we have timing — she will own contract path / procurement questions.

Thanks,
Alex

Hi Alex — nice to meet you over email. Quick notes from security: we can provide a short SOC2 summary and an answers spreadsheet for your security questionnaire. A few clarifying Qs up front so we prepare the right artifacts:

- Do you need an AICPA Type II SOC2 report or is a summary sufficient for procurement to start?
- For SSO, are you planning SAML SSO or OIDC? We have docs for both flows but need the exact connector type
- Any specific data retention / deletion windows required by Finovo?

I’ll start with the SOC2_summary.pdf attached and the checklist; if you can send over the security questionnaire link (or portal), I’ll assign an engineer to complete it.
